description:
Returns an interactive card for hosts that render MCP Apps: either an enforcement case card (kind 'enforcement', with a case id from privacy_search_enforcement_actions) or a Law 25 readiness form (kind 'law25_readiness') whose category picker loads the matching checklist inside the app view. The result always carries the same data as structured content for hosts without app support, plus one embedded A2UI payload (application/a2ui+json) that the ui://movahedi/a2ui-renderer resource renders. Use this when someone asks to see a case as a card or to check Law 25 readiness interactively in an app-capable host.
Use when: Use when someone wants an enforcement case as an interactive card, or a Law 25 readiness form, in a host that renders MCP Apps.
Do not use when: Do not use when someone wants plain data to reason over; use privacy_get_enforcement_case or privacy_law25_requirements instead.

id.description: Enforcement case id, required when kind is 'enforcement'. Find valid ids with privacy_search_enforcement_actions.

kind.description: Which card to return: 'enforcement' for one enforcement case card, 'law25_readiness' for the Law 25 readiness form.

name: privacy_get_a2ui_card

case.description: The enforcement case record, when kind is 'enforcement'.

categories.description: The Law 25 categories the readiness form offers, when kind is 'law25_readiness'.
